note: This record states decisions, not results. It emits no probability, edge or EV. Gate remains 0/100 NO_PROMOTE; model-authorized ledger remains $0; execution remains UNAUTHORIZED.

dispositions.scope: the NFL preseason feature branch cut from the 2026-07-27 checkpoint bundle
dispositions.reason: A 2026-07-27 base is 57 commits stale and predates the entire outcome-label control layer (result_provenance.py, result_content_checks.py, parse_box_dump.py, the registration-required-to-grade gate), the 8/8 results corrections (3 reversed winners), and the V13 freeze. Rebasing is not sufficient reassurance when the branch's only content is a preseason model that is itself being abandoned (see D2).
dispositions.residual_value_retained: NONE from code. The two board defects found while reviewing that work ARE retained, in data/nfl/INTEGRATION_RISK.json and the frozen board.

permitted: capture and freeze market boards as timestamped evaluation records
capture official schedule/kickoff, and record label defects verbatim alongside corrections
capture final scores as tier-1 outcome records
prohibited: any preseason win probability, spread projection, total projection, edge or EV
training any estimator on preseason outcomes
using preseason outcomes as features or validation for the regular-season track
dispositions.reason: Preseason outcomes are driven by planned QB rotation and snap intent, which were never historically captured as of-kickoff state in this repository. Reconstructing them from postgame box scores injects look-ahead. Without a pregame record of rotation/snap intention, a defensible preseason model cannot be trained now — not with more compute, and not with more market data.
dispositions.reopen_condition: Only if pregame rotation/snap-intent records are captured prospectively, as-of kickoff, for a sufficient number of games. That capture may begin at any time; it cannot be backfilled.

dispositions.decision: BUILD as a separate track from current HEAD
dispositions.status_at_record_time: SPEC_ONLY — no data acquired, no estimator fitted, no forecast emitted
dispositions.reason: The regular-season signal set (causal early-down EPA, QB/OL health, opponent adjustment, rest, travel, weather, injuries) is recoverable as of-kickoff state, which is exactly what preseason lacks.

dispositions.decision: ISOLATE — treat as board-integrity defects, not as model input
defects: timestamp/date defect: board prints UTC labeled 'ET'; the uniform -4h correction moves four games to the previous day (LAC@HOU, ARI@LV, TEN@SF Fri 8/14 -> Thu 8/13; DAL@SEA Sun 8/16 -> Sat 8/15)
Caesars sign flips: Caesars posts the opposite favorite from the other three books on at least five games (LAC@HOU, TB@NYJ, MIA@WAS, CAR@BUF, JAX@NO)
dispositions.rule: NEVER average across an unresolved sign flip. A cross-book consensus that averages a flipped line produces a number with no referent — it is neither book's price and no one can transact it. Each book's quote is stored per book. A flip must be resolved to a single orientation by evidence, or that book excluded from that game, before any aggregation.
dispositions.enforced_by: data/nfl/odds/2026-08-13_16_preseason_board.json stores quotes per book with the verbatim label preserved; no consensus/average field exists in the NFL section.

carried_constraints.firewall: data/nfl/** remains isolated from the MLB engine, registries, gate and ledger. Zero edits to MLB artifacts from NFL work.
carried_constraints.model_identity: Any NFL estimator must be registered as a NEW model_id. It may not reuse or extend a V13/V14 identity. V13 is FROZEN as of 2026-08-10.
carried_constraints.price_quarantine: Prices are never features. Forecast first, price second.
